notes.title: Title update 4 is live!
notes.content: [p]We're happy to announce that Title Update #4 for NALE Chapter IV is live![/p][p]This is a big change:[/p][list][*][p][b]Save-Anywhere Function[/b] - You can now hit "esc" (or the matching menu button on whatever controller you're using) to bring up the main menu [b]during dialogue[/b]. This allows players to save the game [i]almost[/i] anywhere, so no waiting for dialogue to end in order to save![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Fast-Forward Function[/b] - In addition to the old feature to fast-forward dialogue, you can now hold the fast-forward button/key to fast-forward [b]cutscenes[/b]. This will speed up all actions x4, allowing you to speed through cutscenes, ideal for players who are replaying the game and want to reach key moments quickly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Typo Fixes [/b]- Thanks to our community, we've been able to fix numerous typos and small errors.[/p][/*][/list][p]Unfortunately, these changes are quite substantial and they will [b]invalidate older saves[/b]. You'll get a message to do this upon trying to load a save or starting a game with invalid saves; sadly this was unavoidable.[/p][p][i]Apologies to anyone affected by this. We held on after release until the number of players had dropped to a small number to try and reduce the number of players that would get caught out. This won't remove achievements or reset game options, and if you're already part-way through, you should be able to use the fast-forward function to reach where you were pretty quickly.[/i][/p][p]Our community has extensively tested these two new features, however, if you encounter any issues, please report them here:[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2124200/discussions/0/594023852480202951/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2124200/discussions/0/594023852480202951/[/url][/p][p][b]Thanks, everyone, for your continued support![/b][/p]

notes.title: NALEC4 Regular Dev Update #4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42950945/2f25476e9f4866695223e1724c0bd9c5ce1b089d.png[/img]

Hi all, and welcome to our 4th development update for [b]Nina Aquila: Legal Eagle, Chapter IV: Sacred Feathers[/b]!

From the start of the year, a big part of our focus has been on the subgame for Chapter IV, which will occupy similar prominence to the card game in Chapter II, or the driving segments of Chapter III. We really wanted to push to make this something unique and special within the RPG Maker space, and we're really happy with how that has come together.

Unfortunately, just like in prior chapters, the nature of the subgame is tied to the story of the chapter, meaning that we don't have any screenshots right now. However, the subgame is "feature complete", now only needing content to be added as we progress through working on the rest of the game.

So with the game written and the subgame made, we're now back to the real core of NALE development - creating the maps, cutscenes and state flow for the actual investigative and court parts of the game!

But we wanted to at least provide something visual with this update, so here's a preview of Chapter IV's title screen:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42950945/e3ad990b90b424e3c5db51d8b58b9bf4fd0c333e.gif[/img]

This also gives an idea of the tone and colour scheme that Chapter IV is going for.

Thanks everyone for following our development! And please remember to follow the game both here and on Twitter for future updates:

https://twitter.com/NinaAquilaGame

notes.title: Regular Dev News #3 - About the Planning Process for NALE
notes.content:
Development continues on NALE Chapter IV, so we're here for a quick update about progress, and some info about changes to Steam's developer pages and how that affects us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42950945/8b3e6ddc06a3c9a3dc6e4a756ee0b7bc05d9a39d.png[/img]

[h1]Written plan is nearly complete![/h1]
This is a big one; the written plan for NALE Chapter IV is nearly complete!

We suspect, for some of you, that might seem anticlimactic (like you were expecting that would've been over ages ago). Being somewhere between adventure game and visual novel, the written plan for a NALE chapter is a huge part of development; easily half the total work involved, at least in terms of the head-scratching, difficult stuff. It involves coming up with the top-level plan of all the case's twists and turns, alongside the emotional arcs for the player and the characters, but then, critically, breaking that down into all of the states we need for implementing the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42950945/5957f909ef63c09fa9b8ca5df6bed55a73469ffe.png[/img]

The plan looks a bit like this; pages and pages of these boxed paragraphs. We've mosaic'd it for spoiler purposes.

The game is structured as a big state machine, where each step of the game is a new high-level state, and things which happen within those states are low-level states. This way, every moment of the game can be broken down to two numbers - what HLS we're in, and what LLS we're in, and in dev terms, we've written tools which allow us to jump around between states, for testing. Additionally, all states are self-contained, meaning problems in one can't affect another, which helps limit bugs.

What this means is that the (near) completion of the written plan is a huge step forward, and once it's complete, full development on Chapter IV in-engine can begin in earnest.

[h1]Change to how Steam manages developer pages (and what that means for you)[/h1]

Steam has made a change to developer pages. Previously, when we posted on our developer page, we could have those posts show up on our games, too, auto-magically. Unfortunately, this has now changed, meaning that posts on each game and the dev page are placed in distinct, separate areas.

What this means for [b]you[/b] is that we're going to have to limit our posting a bit; as a small developer we can't split our focus between multiple games AND our developer page (that just wouldn't work).

So, if you want to keep up with news of NALE Chapter IV, please [b]follow[/b] the game's page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2124200/Nina_Aquila_Legal_Eagle_Chapter_IV_Sacred_Feathers/
(Please note - "follow"; you can wishlist the game too - in fact, please do! But you need to "follow" to receive news updates)

Meanwhile, fans should follow our developer page to expect news about us as developers, which will include major milestones, releases and sales:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TSS/

Naturally, you can also follow us on Twitter:
https://twitter.com/NinaAquilaGame

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]
Thanks everyone! We're going to get back to working on the written plan (with a goal of completing it by the end of Jan), and we'll let you know when that happens.

notes.title: NALEC4 Regular Dev Update #2
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42815562/ff600da6dd81118b27cc244bd5e3feba32ab8d61.png[/img]

Hi all, happy new year and hope you've had a good start to 2023!

Just wanted to update you all on the state of Chapter IV, and a few other bits and pieces.

Chapter IV's written plan is in the late-stages now, with the plot essentially written, but with work to convert that into a development plan. Similar to how previous chapters were worked up, this involves breaking down the plot into a series of consecutive states, working out what assets are needed, and making sure the right evidence etc. exists at each point of the game. However, it's fair to say this process has "turned a corner" now and once this plan is complete, we can start map-making and scripting.

Additionally, watch out for NALE Season One showing up in a few exciting places... Unfortunately that's all we can say right now, but keep an eye out!

notes.title: NALEC4 Regular Dev Update #1
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42815562/5f3e6099b482c3fd709bd9f3e9341d00c757b004.png[/img]
Hi all! This entry starts what will be a series of regular development updates about NALEC4, or [i]Nina Aquila: Legal Eagle, Chapter IV: "Sacred Feathers"[/i].

The goal is for these to be [i]weekly[/i] updates, however, we'll only post when there's actually something to report, so we're calling them "regular" updates instead.

[h1]Keeping up with updates[/h1]
If you're seeing this, that means you probably [b]follow[/b] something here on Steam related to us. We really recommend, if you want to keep up with things, to follow either [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2124200/Nina_Aquila_Legal_Eagle_Chapter_IV_Sacred_Feathers/]the game[/url], or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TSS]our developer page[/url].

Make sure you follow, NOT "wishlist", as wishlists only get you notified of price drops. Obviously you CAN do both.

[h1]Story Updates[/h1]
One of the biggest parts of NALE development that we can't talk much about (as it's too spoiler-ridden) is story development. We only announced the existence of NALEC4 when we had a story treatment with which we were happy, but that's nowhere near finished. We still need to do quite a bit of work on paper, so that work is ongoing right now. We hope to have updates about this in the near future.

[h1]NALES1 Sale![/h1]
Due to the £sterling crashing vs. the dollar, and us being based in the UK, we're having a 7-day 50% off sale for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1547290/Nina_Aquila_Legal_Eagle_Season_One/]Nina Aquila: Legal Eagle, Season One[/url]. Sales of this, either for yourself or as a gift to someone else, count for more in our budget than ever before, so if you've been considering getting NALE, we recommend doing that now!

[b]Thanks, everyone, for being part of NALE's journey up to this point. See you next time![/b]
